claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition E-03 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F02 in context; type IMPLIED; THERAPEUTIC; CONDITION-SPECIFIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: VERY LIMITED DIRECT EVIDENCE — GROUNDING COMPONENT NOT ISOLABLE. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION — note that the historical negative-search state for menopause was INVALIDATED by H33 and must not be reinstated.
claim.claim_scope: GROUNDING COMPONENT NOT ISOLABLE | HIGH CONFOUNDING | PRODUCT MISMATCH | PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN | REPLICATION ABSENT
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: Premium Grounding is relevant to/alleviates menopause symptoms.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: Nonrandom allocation, partly nonconcurrent collection, re-enrolment, differential attrition, self-report, no preregistration
No equal-exercise, shod-walking or sham-grounding control
Exercise, nature, social, researcher, sensory and soil components inseparable

evidence_items.text: Kim M-H & Lee E-Y 2025: quasi-experimental nonequivalent control, 73 enrolled and 60 analysed (29 intervention, 31 control), women with Menopause Rating Scale at or above 8; 60 minutes, three times weekly for 12 weeks on a maintained 2.7 km soil forest trail with barefoot soil contact. Menopausal symptoms z=-5.59, p<.001; stress z=-3.58, p<.001; quality of life z=-3.47, p=.001; sleep time-by-group F=7.53, p=.008.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Genuine condition-relevant direct exposure in a symptomatic population with large reported effects on a condition-specific instrument.

evidence_items.text: Allocation was nonrandom, collection partly nonconcurrent, some prior controls were later re-enrolled, outcomes were self-reported, attrition was differential (10 of 39 intervention dropouts versus 3 of 34 controls), and there was no preregistration.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Design and reporting features that individually and jointly undermine causal attribution.

evidence_items.text: There was no equal-exercise, shod-walking or sham-grounding control; exercise, walking, forest and nature exposure, social and group contact, researcher support, sensory stimulation and soil contact are inseparable.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The comparator equalised none of the cointerventions, so the grounding component cannot be isolated from the programme as a whole.

evidence_items.text: No Premium Grounding product was used; the intervention was barefoot walking on a soil forest trail. Replication is absent.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Product mismatch and a single unreplicated programme.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: A real condition-relevant exposure exists, but its design cannot attribute any part of the effect to grounding, and no product was tested.
supporting: H33 menopause z=-5.59, p<.001; stress z=-3.58; QoL z=-3.47; sleep time-by-group F=7.53, p=.008

detected.rationale: The design cannot separate grounding from exercise, nature exposure, social contact and researcher attention, so no causal link to grounding is established.
A product benefit for menopause symptoms is implied from a barefoot forest-walking programme that used no product and isolated no component.

reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the product has been shown to relieve menopause symptoms.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Menopause symptom management has effective options; implied product relevance may displace them.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label applies. A mechanism_vs_evidence reading was rejected: no preclinical pathway is extrapolated — the defect is that a real human condition study cannot attribute its effect to grounding.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — the Steelman layer established a genuine, condition-relevant and statistically strong human study; the adversarial layer established that none of its effect is attributable to grounding. Resolved as OVERCLAIM with the mandatory qualifier GROUNDING COMPONENT NOT ISOLABLE carried on the verdict, and the positive study explicitly preserved.
missing_evidence: Nonrandom allocation, partly nonconcurrent collection, re-enrolment, differential attrition, self-report, no preregistration
No equal-exercise, shod-walking or sham-grounding control
Exercise, nature, social, researcher, sensory and soil components inseparable
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A randomised barefoot or Earth-contact versus shod or sham trial equalising exercise, environment, social and researcher exposure and measurement schedule has not been performed.

verdict.verdict_summary: This is the only advertised condition with a condition-relevant human Earth-contact study, and its reported effects are large. But allocation was nonrandom, the comparator equalised nothing, no product was involved, and exercise, walking, forest exposure, social contact, researcher attention, sensory stimulation and soil contact cannot be separated. Nothing in it is attributable to grounding.
